539-2292-3821-4679-6821.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-2292-3821-4679-6821.description:
Cause Peregrine Drake to become an enchantment using Jump Scare.
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-7752-8201.easyPrerequisites: You've cast a noncreature spell this turn.
3259-7752-8201.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7752-8201.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Council of Reeds triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

3755-4871-5220-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
3755-4871-5220-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.
3755-4871-5220-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3388-4661.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3388-4661.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Moritte of the Frost and Vesuvan Doppelganger each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Vesuvan Doppelganger trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3388-4661.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1090-1739-3375-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

3532-3581-5078-6792.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3581-5078-6792.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Mm'menon.
Repeat.

777-3532-5078-7719.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
The Astonishing Ant-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

4636-5159-5491.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a 4/4 artifact creature token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart named Mishra's Warform and a Map token.
When the Map and Mishra's Warform enters the battlefield, Mishra's Warform and Gonti's Aether Heart trigger twice each, causing you to get eight {E}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying eight {E} and exiling it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1445-2511-4871-7396.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2511-4871-7396.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

507-3213.description:
Whenever a player casts a spell from their hand, Possibility Storm triggers, exiling the spell and allowing the player to reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a spell that shares a type with the exiled spell, and cast it without paying its mana cost.
If the player chooses to cast the spell, Boromir triggers, countering that spell since no mana was spent to cast it.

955-3094-4659-5390-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
955-3094-4659-5390-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {2} due to Forensic Gadgeteer and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

745-877-6967.description:
Cast Mirrorhall Mimic by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Honest Rutstein.
Put Honest Rutstein into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Mirrorhall Mimic triggers, returning Honest Rutstein from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Honest Rutstein by paying {0} due to Morophon and Mirrorhall Mimic
Put Honest Rutstein into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Honest Rutstein triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1726-2034-6972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scrapyard Recombiner.
When Scrapyard Recombiner dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Scrapyard Recombiner's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Scrapyard Recombiner from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

6702-7009-7068.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
6702-7009-7068.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Kilo, or you have another method to tap Kilo.
6702-7009-7068.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Baboon Spirit triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with a lore counter on it.
The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Tap Kilo, either by attacking or by using another method. Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-5663-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cayth.
When Cayth dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cayth enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power X or greater

1336-1978-5143.description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Heronblade Elite.
Repeat

345-5641-6012.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Reluctant Role Model's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

1274-2275-2541.description:
Activate Benthic Biomancer by paying {1}{U}, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Repeat from step 2.
1274-2275-2541.notes: If Benthic Biomancer has a +1/+1 counter on it, you cannot use its adapt ability, and will need another way to put a counter on it. You can start the combo at steps 3/4 to accomplish this, or use any other method. This will also remove the mana requirement.

4029-4968-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Benevolent Hydra.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
4029-4968-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar if desired.

742-1061.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U}{U}{B} the first turn, with {3}{U}{U}{U} each extra turn
742-1061.easyPrerequisites: You have six or more cards in your library.
742-1061.description:
During your upkeep, activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your draw step, and draw a card.
Cast Demonic Consultation by paying {1}{B}, naming Timestream Navigator and exiling your entire library except Timestream Navigator and putting Timestream Navigator into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
During your extra turn's upkeep, activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your draw step, drawing Timestream Navigator.
Repeat from step 4.

requires.n: Creature with MV=1 and Creates Creature Token(s) on Death

2178-2921-6542--110.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with mana value 0.
2178-2921-6542--110.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with mana value 0.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning the creature that creates creature token(s) on death from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, it and Sidisi trigger.
Resolve the Sidisi trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the creature's trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

3941-4067-6072-6281.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Graveshifter.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Graveshifter that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Graveshifter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Graveshifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Repeat.

855-2060-2092-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
855-2060-2092-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

1170-1645-5334-5478-5954.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

372-864-961.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Against All Odds exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-864-961.description:
Cast Against All Odds by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Eternal Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Eternal Witness trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Against All Odds from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Against All Odds.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Eternal Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1479-3147-5671.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3147-5671.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it, The Necrobloom, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and The Necrobloom trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1308-4094-4636-5770.easyPrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
1308-4094-4636-5770.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating four 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beasts enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers four times, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-5544-5688.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, adding {B}.
When Forsaken Miner dies, Judith triggers.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Judith trigger, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Repeat.

3259-4068-4191-5022.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to a nontoken creature you control with mana value 3 or less.
You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
3259-4068-4191-5022.description:
Declare Treasury Thrull and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Treasury Thrull triggers, returning a creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast the creature by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature with mana value 3 or less, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

224-1361-2119-4096.notablePrerequisites: Goblin Welder does not have summoning sickness.
224-1361-2119-4096.description:
Activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, causing you to sacrifice Ancient Den and return Seat of the Synod from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Seat of the Synod enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm, untapping Goblin Welder.
Activate Seat of the Synod by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, causing you to sacrifice Seat of the Synod and return Ancient Den from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Ancient Den enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm, untapping Goblin Welder.
Activate Ancient Den by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1738-5253.notablePrerequisites:
Brion does not have summoning sickness.
Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
1738-5253.description:
Activate Brion by paying {R}, tapping it and sacrificing Serra Avatar, dealing damage equal to Serra Avatar's power to target opponent with a life total equal to or less than your life total and causing you to gain that much life.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

2724-3194-4428.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Thassa. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
